This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Air preheater wash water 
pumps (2 per unit) are
supplied from the service water system to the two P/Ps any of the two P/Ps is
used to wash any of the two air preheater as the discharge piping of the two
air heaters wash P/Ps is common

The technical specification of the condensate pump: 
R.P.M = 1450 
Suction pressure:304.8 mm H2O
T = 94/25 C 
Discharge pressure: 6096 mm H2O

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.
